gen-gf-gugi-fs-asap: Gugi draws tall, bold lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals, with open terminals that let each counter flow outward. Gugi makes the statement; Asap, a sans, does the quiet readable work.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-amulya: One-nib swagger, with open terminals letting the counters flow outward, comes from Gabarito up top. Gabarito's flat, unmodulated line is the standout, while Amulya, a plain sans, keeps its curve gaps generous.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-chillax: Gabarito looks expressive and drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open so every counter flows outward. Chillax, a plain sans, loops along like spaghetti, casual and relaxed.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-spline-sans: Nib-drawn and expressive, Gabarito cuts its terminals open so counters flow outward, while Spline Sans keeps wide gaps at curve ends. Expressive display up top, approachable sans-serif beneath, and nothing cramped.
gen-gf-gabarito-outfit: Expressive Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, terminals cut open. Outfit, a sans-serif, runs on after it like bent cable, smooth and approachable, curves finishing before they close, so a paragraph glides along.
gen-gf-metamorphous-manrope: Commanding and spacious, Metamorphous thins its curves modestly at the turns, while Manrope, a sans-serif, holds one width throughout. One leans on soft contrast, the other on steady line.
gen-gf-oxanium-montserrat: Montserrat reads open, geometric and approachable, a sans gliding like wire. Oxanium above it is commanding, with monoline strokes and a high x-height, so pages of text keep moving.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp, thick through the middle, its plain sans letters held open. Revalia is the one to show off, striding widely with an open-curved g, while Supreme does the steady carrying.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-familjen-grotesk: Wide-set and commanding, Goldman gives its round forms open-parenthesis curves, while Familjen Grotesk leaves its bowls unfinished on one side. Both stand tall in the lowercase, one bold, one lively.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-work-sans: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height, with terminal tips pointing outward. And Work Sans, a plain sans with a high mean line, sits beside it as a modern, level partner.
